hla_source_basis: Published HLA-LA summary, read through web tool; fresh direct HTML fetch returned HTTP 403.
limitations: Screen of the reconstructed FTH1 residues 1-17 plus FTL residues 14-175 sequence only; other FTH1-FTL isoforms were not screened.
Peptide-only EL and BA models; no context encoding or optional fine-tuned neoepitope mode.
Class-II DP and DQ were not screened.
Novelty is against the two canonical parents, not the complete human proteome.
Overlapping DRB3 positives share a single core and are not independent epitopes.
Predictions do not establish expression, antigen presentation, T-cell recognition or historic vaccine selection reasons.
